payload.name: Extract all distinct durable facts per message
payload.description: During extraction, when one message contains two or more independent durable facts about a person, create a separate memory candidate for each fact; do not keep only the most prominent or emotionally salient one.
content: During extraction, if a single message states multiple distinct durable facts about the speaker or another person (e.g., receiving a specific item and experiencing a life event), emit each fact as its own candidate memory instead of combining them or keeping only one.

When one fact is emotionally prominent (e.g., a job loss), do not let it suppress other explicitly stated durable facts in the same message; each explicit durable claim remains eligible for extraction.
Stop after capturing each explicitly stated durable fact; do not infer additional facts or expand beyond the message's content.

solves: During construction extraction, a single message can contain multiple distinct durable facts, but the extractor sometimes captures only the most salient or emotionally prominent one and drops the others. This skill ensures that every explicitly stated durable fact in a message is emitted as its own candidate memory, so later questions about any of those facts can be answered.
